title: AAV-Mediated Gene Delivery to hiPSC-Derived Microglia for Functional Studies
author: Heiss, Mihai, et al.

steps.title: Seed hiMG on coverslips
steps.instruction: Harvest hiMG as described earlier and seed onto sterile, autoclaved 8 mm uncoated coverslips placed in a 48‑well plate (coverslips should be at least 3 mm smaller than the well diameter for easy removal). Use sterile forceps to position the coverslips.

steps.title: Fix cells with Histofix
steps.instruction: At the end of the experiment remove media, wash cells with sterile PBS, add 200 µL Histofix per well for 12 min at room temperature (RT), then remove Histofix and add 200–300 µL PBS. Cells may be stored at 4 °C for 1–2 weeks before staining.

steps.title: Day 1: Primary antibody staining
steps.instruction: Prepare TBS solution (store at RT) and fresh blocking buffer (keep cool). Wash cells 3 × 5 min with 200 µL TBS, then add 200 µL blocking buffer for 1 h at RT. Dilute primary antibody in blocking buffer (e.g., rat IBA1 1:500), add 100 µL per well, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Day 2: Secondary antibody staining
steps.instruction: Wash off primary antibody 3 × 5 min with 200 µL TBS. Prepare secondary antibody in blocking buffer (e.g., donkey anti‑rat Alexa Fluor 488 1:500) protected from light. Add 100 µL secondary per well and incubate 1 h at RT in the dark. Wash 200 µL TBS for 5 min, then add 200 µL TBS containing DAPI 1:1000 for 7 min (protected from light). Wash again with 200 µL TBS for 5 min, followed by a final wash with 200 µL dH₂O for 3 min.

steps.title: Mount coverslips with ProLong Gold
steps.instruction: Place a 5 µL drop of ProLong Gold on a glass slide. Using thin forceps, lift each coverslip from the well, orient the cell‑side down onto the drop, and gently press to remove bubbles. Repeat for all coverslips (2–6 per slide). Store slides at RT protected from light for at least 24 h; long‑term storage at 4 °C is recommended.

steps.title: Image stained cells
steps.instruction: After slides have dried ≥24 h, image cells on a fluorescence microscope (e.g., Nikon Ti Eclipse inverted with Andor Zyla sCMOS camera) using a 20× air objective and appropriate filter sets.

steps.title: Prepare hiMG for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: At ≥5 days post‑AAV transduction, wash adherent hiMG with DPBS−/−, add 50 µL 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C. Inactivate trypsin with 150 µL FACS buffer (PBS + FBS). Add LIVE/DEAD™ Fixable Far‑Red dye 1:1000, mix gently, transfer suspensions to 1.5 mL tubes, and centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at RT. Discard supernatant, add one drop NucBlue™ per 0.5 mL cell suspension, resuspend in cold FACS buffer, incubate 10–15 min on ice, keep on ice. Centrifuge again 300 × g 5 min RT, resuspend in 0.5 mL cold FACS buffer, transfer to flow cytometry tubes, and keep on ice until acquisition.

steps.title: Set up flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Calibrate the BD LSRFortessa and optimize voltages using BD FACSDiva™ software. Prepare compensation controls with UltraComp eBeads™ Plus or single‑color cells. Create an acquisition worksheet with the following gating hierarchy: (i) total cells – FSC‑A vs SSC‑A; (ii) singlets – FSC‑A vs FSC‑H; (iii) live nucleated cells – viability dye‑negative (APC) vs NucBlue™ (BV421); (iv) transduction marker – mScarlet (PE) vs FSC‑A.

steps.title: Acquire and process flow data
steps.instruction: Run a test sample to set a flow rate of 1,000–5,000 events / s. Acquire all samples, export data as .FSC files, and import into FlowJo™. Apply the compensation matrix derived from single‑color controls to all samples, then analyze using the defined gating strategy.

steps.title: Analyze calcium imaging in Fiji
steps.instruction: Open Fiji/ImageJ, load the saved .nd2 file (File → Open). Set measurements to ‘Mean gray value’ (Analyze → Set measurements). Optionally adjust brightness/contrast or perform background subtraction. Open ROI Manager (Analyze → Tools → ROI Manager), manually draw freehand ROIs avoiding autofluorescent cells, click ‘Add [t]’ to save each ROI, and repeat for all desired cells. Measure fluorescence (ROI Manager → More → Multi Measure) with ‘Measure all X slices’ and ‘One row per slice’ selected, then click OK. Export results via File → Save As… as .csv (or .txt). Analyze the exported data with any preferred software.
